g.text: The κ pilot measures a retention–tail trade-off
Development evidence: preliminary hints; declared gain not established
κ arms reduce ES95 descriptively but miss the retention floor and declared tail-separation rule.
DEC-054: not coupled free energy, a coupled blanket, or a one-κ test. This is a loss-level pilot.
Claims: kappa-design, kappa-ordinary, kappa-kappa02, kappa-kappa05, kappa-clip2
